summary: decision-map revise that only adds a gate question and cancels one legacy item marks every other current work item (including the reviser's own in_progress claim) as needs_review and blocked, requiring a second 'keep' revision; it also stales the reviser's saved context.
expected: Adding a question node/edges, changing focus and cancelling one named legacy item (dbbfbb3d) should leave unrelated current work (P3 in_progress by the same actor, P4/P5 todo, P6 blocked) claimable and not in needs_review, or the CLI should say up front which work needs explicit keep treatment.
actual: After revision 252496e4, resume showed 'Blocked: Decision review required: <full map rationale repeated>' on P3, P4, P5 and P6 and needs_review listed all four. Clearing it took a second revise (7318ce7b) with identical map content and four 'keep' work_treatments carrying the current versions (3,2,2,2), which bumped every work version again. The P3 saved context 41cb0530 (map 5a9efd49, work v2) is now stale against map 7318ce7b / work v4, so the package needs fresh context before submitting.
reproduction: In crous-queue: python3 tools/foundry_agent.py cli decision-map revise --workspace-id 81ee3117-de70-411e-9856-07420859ffad --input .foundry/runs/p3-map.json (adds question node five_lunch_coverage_gate, edges, focus, cancel dbbfbb3d v3), then resume. Then revise again with .foundry/runs/p3-map-keep.json.
impact: Two revisions and four version bumps for one hygiene change; the full rationale is repeated per item in resume (noisy); an agent following the brief literally (pin expected_head from saved context) would submit a stale result.
suggestion: Have revise accept a default treatment ('keep unmentioned current work') or compute needs_review only for work whose map node/edges changed; print the list of work needing treatment in the revise response; truncate repeated rationale in resume.
